dataset.description:
The dataset contains the results for our research on the coverage of DOAJ journals' citations through OpenCitations. 
More specifically, JSON and CSV files depending on the kind of data and operations at each step. 
They will contain: 
  • Journals and metadata about it (ISSN, EISSN)
  • Citations count for each journal (made by)
  • Citations count for each journal (made to)
  • Open citations count made by each journal
  • Open citations grouped by year
dataset.title: Dataset for Coverage of DOAJ journals' citations through OpenCitations

dataset.description:
This dataset contains the software used for our research.
This code process the public data dumps from DOAJ and OpenCitations. 
The Python script uses libraries such as Request, Pandas, Tarfile and plotly for gathering, manipulating, analyzing and visualizing the data of this research.
dataset.title: Software for Coverage of DOAJ journals' citations through OpenCitations

dmp.description:
This is the Data Management Plan for the research "Coverage of DOAJ journals' citations through OpenCitations" made in the context of the Open Science course of 21/22 of University of Bologna held by professor Silvio Peroni.

The purpose of this research was to scrutinize the citations made and received by the journals published in the DOAJ open access journal database, the change in these citations over the years and the scope of these citations.

This DMP will help outline the ways in which we collected, generated and processed the data for our research. But not only that, it will also ensure the availability and utility of this data, showing the compliance with the FAIR principles.
dmp.title: Coverage of DOAJ journals' citations through OpenCitations (Data Management Plan)
